### Bible Pathway - May 26
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-26-2013.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 19:2
Points:
- Although Jehoshaphat was generally a godly reformer, he compromised by forming an alliance with the idolatrous King Ahab.
- Jehoshaphat disregarded a true prophet's warning, leading to a disastrous battle from which the Lord graciously spared him.
- The Lord dispatched the seer Jehu to reprove him because assisting and promoting ungodliness is a transgression against God.
- God balances justice with compassion, recognizing Jehoshaphat's repentant heart and the good works he had done.
